checked_sources.inspection: All six fooling-set witness records inspected.
Exact semantic search; own record was the direct match.
Gillis–Glineur primary paper record/full-text source checked for general rank-3 nonnegative-rank geometry; it does not give this finite binary census.
Beasley–Laffey gap literature checked for implication; isolated lower-dimensional examples do not furnish the 5-by-5 classification.

correctness.reason: A fresh exact implementation independently enumerated all 376,992 column multisets, computed ordinary rank using integer elimination, reproduced the full rank histogram and the 63,015 rank-3 multisets, canonicalized under row/column permutations and transpose to exactly 719 classes, then established 713 nonnegative-rank-3 cases by exact rational nonnegative three-generator factorizations and the remaining six as rank 4 via explicit four-point fooling sets. No case remained unresolved.
correctness.risk: Canonicalization and finite enumeration are software-assisted, though the fresh implementation used exact integer/rational checks for the scientific classification.

final_claim: Up to row and column permutations and transpose, exactly 719 binary 5-by-5 matrices have ordinary rank 3; 713 have nonnegative rank 3 and six have nonnegative rank 4, so none in this stratum has nonnegative rank 5.

originality.reason: Published-results search found the exact census only in this record. Gillis–Glineur provides general rank-3 geometric theory, and Beasley–Laffey supplies isolated lower-dimensional gap patterns, but neither gives the complete binary 5-by-5 ordinary-rank-3 classification. No exact 719-class table was found elsewhere.
originality.risk: A non-indexed computational table could exist; search cannot prove universal absence.

originality_checks.broader_coverage: General geometric/nonnegative-rank theory and lower-dimensional examples do not classify the finite binary 5-by-5 stratum.
originality_checks.claim_vs_prior_implication: Known existence of rank-3 versus nonnegative-rank-4 examples does not imply that only six classes occur or that nonnegative rank 5 is absent.
originality_checks.equivalent_formulations: Searched ordinary-rank-3 binary 5-by-5 matrices, nonnegative rank, fooling sets, monomial equivalence, and the exact counts 719/713/6.
originality_checks.exact_database_or_table: No external table with 719 canonical classes or the 713/6 split was located.

residual_risks: Canonicalization and finite enumeration are software-assisted, though the fresh implementation used exact integer/rational checks for the scientific classification.

value.reason: This is a natural complete classification at the first small binary square size where a rank versus nonnegative-rank gap is visible, with direct relevance to nonnegative factorization and extension complexity; the exact no-rank-5 boundary is a reusable finite fact.
